name: Singita Faru Faru Lodge

address.street: Grumeti Reserves Serengeti National Park TZ

insider_take: Singita Faru Faru Lodge sits in the heart of the Serengeti's most exclusive wildlife corridor, where the Great Migration thunders past your suite twice yearly.
whats_special: This ultra-luxury safari lodge occupies a prime position in the Grumeti Reserve, a pristine 350,000-acre private concession. The property features just 9 suites, each with panoramic views of the Grumeti River where hippos and crocodiles congregate. The lodge's contemporary African design includes a stunning infinity pool that appears to merge with the endless plains.
pro_tip: Book during June-July or December-January to witness the Great Migration river crossings directly from your suite's private deck.
dont_miss: The lodge's world-class spa treatments overlooking the river, night game drives exclusive to Grumeti guests, and helicopter safaris offering aerial views of the migration. The property also features Tanzania's most extensive wine cellar and hosts legendary riverside dinners under ancient fig trees.
pros: Prime location in Serengeti National Park with exceptional wildlife viewing opportunities
Ultra-luxury safari lodge with sophisticated contemporary design and premium amenities
World-class guided game drives and expert naturalist guides
Award-winning spa and wellness facilities in pristine wilderness setting
cons: Ultra-premium pricing reflects exclusive luxury positioning
Remote wilderness location requires chartered flights for access
